provenance.note: The variant is the dotted <provider>.<stream> string the fetcher was configured with, so the variant space is open rather than enumerable -- detection reads the value, it does not match it against a list. This is the case the user named: cloudwatch -> beats -> es -> receiver collapses to dfe-fetcher -> transform, because the Agent input for CloudTrail is pure transport and the parsing all lives in the ingest pipeline.
